description:
PACO is a personal concierge service in Lisbon. Its team handles
real-world tasks for members: booking restaurants and appointments,
contacting suppliers and services, running errands, handling paperwork,
and following up on anything outstanding.

With this plugin, PACO members can submit a request without leaving the
conversation, see what the team is currently working on, add notes to an
existing request, and cancel anything no longer needed. Requests go
straight to the PACO team, who carry them out and update the status as
they progress.

Available to active PACO members. Sign in with your PACO account to
connect.

defaultPrompt: Ask PACO to book a table for four this Saturday evening.
What is PACO working on for me?
Ask PACO to get three quotes for the bathroom repair.
